entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Powerful wizard and leader of the Conclave of Mages after the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: School of mages on Terisiare that Ith led and later destroyed.

entities.name: Barl's Cage
entities.description: Cage in which Ith was imprisoned, siphoning his mana.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Pretender who imprisoned Ith and was later killed by him.

entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: Messenger specter Ith summoned to find help.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Wizard brought to the Conclave who helped free Ith and restored his sanity.

entities.name: Reflecting Mirror
entities.description: Mirror Jodah used to restore Ith's sanity.

entities.name: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Destruction of the Conclave by Ith.

entities.name: Barl
entities.description: Original holder of the title Lord Ith in older continuity.

events.summary: Mairsil imprisons Ith in Barl's Cage for a dozen years, siphoning his mana while Ith slides into madness.
events.quote: Ith was imprisoned in Barl's Cage for a dozen years by Mairsil, the Pretender .

events.summary: Ith summons a Rag Man, which finds Jodah and brings him to the Conclave.
events.quote: The Rag Man tracked down Jodah and brought him to the Conclave of Mages .

events.summary: Jodah and Sima free Ith by destroying the cage.
events.quote: Jodah and Sima eventually freed Ith by destroying the cage.

events.summary: Ith attacks the Conclave and kills Mairsil before Jodah restores his sanity with the mirror.
events.quote: An enraged Ith attacked the Conclave and killed Mairsil before Jodah used his mirror to restore his sanity.

events.summary: Ith frightens the remaining mages away and destroys the whole school.
participants: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
events.quote: Ith then caused the Fall of the Conclave of Mages , destroying the entire school before retreating to be by himself.

relations.quote: He was leader of the Conclave of Mages .

relations.note: Imprisoned Ith, who later killed him.
relations.quote: Ith was imprisoned in Barl's Cage for a dozen years by Mairsil, the Pretender .

relations.note: Ith killed Mairsil after being freed.
relations.quote: An enraged Ith attacked the Conclave and killed Mairsil
Jodah and Sima eventually freed Ith by destroying the cage.
